evals.name: bugfix-research
evals.setup: Repo state of feat/booker-business-hours-warning, checked out as main, clean working tree.
evals.prompt: o isOutsideBusinessHours (packages/features/bookings/Booker/utils/businessHours.ts) trata durationInMinutes negativo como se fosse zero — um slot das 17h com duração -30 passa como dentro do horário. arruma isso e garante que tem teste cobrindo
evals.expected_output: Branch fix/<slug> off main, specs/<slug>/research.md describing current behaviour and an open question on warn-vs-silent; no source edits, no plan.md

assertions.text: A new branch with a fix/ prefix was created before research.md was written; nothing was committed on main
specs/<slug>/research.md exists, in English, with Task, Current Behavior, Relevant Files and Open Questions sections
research.md is the only file created under specs/<slug>/ — no plan.md, design.md or other template copies, and specs/_templates was not copied wholesale
git status shows no modified or new files outside specs/<slug>/ — businessHours.ts and its test are untouched
research.md names businessHours.ts and businessHours.test.ts with the line where a negative duration slips through
research.md records an open question on whether a negative duration should warn or stay silent, noting the docstring's 'staying silent beats warning wrongly' rule

evals.name: feature-research
evals.setup: Repo state of main (no root CLAUDE.md), clean working tree.
evals.prompt: quero deixar o horário comercial configurável por usuário em vez de chumbado em 08:00-18:00: hora de início e fim no perfil, com o default atual. isso vai mexer em banco, prisma, trpc e na UI do perfil, além do Booker que já consome a constante
evals.expected_output: research.md maps every layer (prisma, tRPC profile router, profile UI, Booker consumers, locale), records storage and whose-hours questions, handles the missing CLAUDE.md without creating it

assertions.text: research.md lists real paths for each layer: prisma schema, the tRPC updateProfile router, the profile settings UI, the Booker code that consumes the business-hours constant, and the en locale
research.md records at least the storage trade-off (dedicated columns vs metadata JSON) and whose hours the Booker should use as open questions
The root CLAUDE.md was checked for and, being absent, noted as absent — no CLAUDE.md was created, copied or fetched from another branch
research.md is the only file created under specs/<slug>/; no design.md, no decisions.md, no broken CLAUDE.md symlink copied from _templates
No file outside specs/<slug>/ was modified

evals.name: working-tree-research
evals.setup: main with uncommitted changes to businessHours.ts, businessHours.test.ts, BookEventForm.tsx and en/common.json (the diff of feat/booker-business-hours-warning minus CLAUDE.md).
evals.prompt: já mexi em algumas coisas aqui no working tree, dá uma olhada no que está modificado e fecha isso num commit e num PR pra mim
evals.expected_output: Branches off main carrying the changes, writes research.md describing the uncommitted diff, leaves the four files untouched, hands over to plan instead of committing

assertions.text: A new branch was created and the four uncommitted files are still modified on it, unchanged
research.md lists all four modified files and what each change does
No commit was made — the run stops after research and points to the plan step
